title: Smoothed Picard Hamiltonian Monte Carlo
abstract: arXiv:2609.06906v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We develop a new low-accuracy sampler, called \emph{smoothed Picard Hamiltonian Monte Carlo}, which combines Gaussian smoothing, Picard iteration, and higher-order discretization. For a log-concave target $\pi \propto \exp(-V)$ in dimension $d$ satisfying $0 \prec \alpha I \preceq \nabla^2 V \preceq \beta I$, with condition number $\kappa := \beta/\alpha$, smoothed Picard HMC returns a sample with $\sqrt \alpha\,W_2(\cdot,\pi) \le \varepsilon$ using $\widetilde O(\kappa^2 + \kappa^{7/6} d^{1/6}/\varepsilon^{1/3})$ gradient queries. We also prove stronger $W_q$ bounds, and then develop an algorithmic framework, the recursive warm start generator, to upgrade these $W_q$ bounds to stronger divergence guarantees. This produces a warm start for the proximal bouncy particle sampler, introduced in a companion work, leading to a high-accuracy log-concave sampler with complexity $\widetilde O((\kappa^{7/6} d^{1/6} + \kappa^{1/2} d^{1/4})\mathrm

translated_title: 平滑皮卡德哈密顿蒙特卡罗
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一种新的低精度采样器，称为平滑皮卡德哈密顿蒙特卡罗，它结合了高斯平滑、皮卡德迭代和高阶离散化方法。对于维度为 $d$、满足 $0 \prec \alpha I \preceq \nabla^2 V \preceq \beta I$ 的对数凹目标分布 $\pi \propto \exp(-V)$（其中条件数 $\kappa := \beta/\alpha$），平滑皮卡德HMC仅需 $\widetilde O(\kappa^2 + \kappa^{7/6} d^{1/6}/\varepsilon^{1/3})$ 次梯度查询即可返回满足 $\sqrt \alpha\,W_2(\cdot,\pi) \le \varepsilon$ 的样本。我们还证明了更强的 $W_q$ 界，并进一步开发了一种算法框架——递归温启动生成器——将这些 $W_q$ 界升级为更强的散度保证。这为配套工作中提出的近端弹跳粒子采样器提供了温启动，从而构建出复杂度为 $\widetilde O((\kappa^{7/6} d^{1/6} + \kappa^{1/2} d^{1/4})\cdots$ 的高精度对数凹采样器。
tldr: 该论文提出平滑皮卡德哈密顿蒙特卡罗采样器，通过融合高斯平滑、皮卡德迭代和高阶离散化，对对数凹分布采样实现了改进的复杂度保证，并借助递归温启动生成器框架将其升级为高精度采样方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the smoothed Picard Hamiltonian Monte Carlo sampler, which combines Gaussian smoothing, Picard iteration, and higher-order discretization to achieve improved complexity guarantees for log-concave sampling, and develops a recursive warm start generator framework to upgrade these guarantees into a high-accuracy sampler.
